verified_manifest_seed.description: Leasehold 2nd Floor Studio Flat Unmodernised Vacant
verified_manifest_seed.evidence: Contemporaneous 28 October 2014 Stack Overflow question preserves raw EIG HTML from the Savills full-details page, including auctioneer Savills (London - National), auctioneerid=55, auctionid=17999, lotid=756425, Lot 2, address, guide, description and catalogue PDF URL. The companion question states the page contained 232 such tables.

attempted_route: URL-parameter archaeology around the legacy Savills ASP.NET catalogue endpoint and contemporaneous indexed inbound links for 28 October 2014.
result: A materially stronger surviving manifest namespace was recovered via contemporaneous raw EIG HTML: Savills auctioneerid 55, auctionid 17999, lotid 756425, Lot 2, and files/55/17999 catalogue namespace. This supplies an auction-native enumeration key but does not by itself satisfy the requested PropertyAuctions AID/Auc reconciliation, so no canonical event was inserted.
blocker: The 28 October 2014 auction now has a source-defensible EIG auction/lot namespace, but a surviving PropertyAuctions AID/Auc mapping for auction 17999 / lot 756425 has not yet been recovered. Canonical insertion remains unsafe until cross-source reconciliation or equivalent source-specific validation is completed.
distinct_next_route: Exploit the recovered EIG auctionid=17999 and files/55/17999 namespace to enumerate the full 28 October 2014 lot manifest breadth-first (the contemporaneous parser author reported 232 table records), extract exact lot numbers/addresses/lotids/catalogue PDFs, filter commercial/mixed clues, then invert those exact identities into PropertyAuctions AID/Auc records. This is distinct from generic PropertyAuctions traversal and from Savills catalogue parameter search.
